title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Kenyan President Ruto
author: Office of the Spokesman
summary:
Office of the Spokesman

Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Kenyan President Ruto

Readout

September 21, 2026

The below is attributable to Spokesman Tommy Pigott:

Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Kenyan President William Ruto to discuss commercial diplomacy and regional peace and security. They spoke about how critical minerals opportunities in Kenya can position the country as a key player in the sector while presenting opportunities for U.S. firms to provide value addition.  As a major non-NATO ally and growing trade relationship, Kenya remains a vital United States partner for shared priorities in the region.  The Secretary expressed appreciation for Kenya’s partnership with the U.S. Government to implement a new and holistic approach to our historic health partnership through the America First Global Health Strategy. Additionally, the Secretary underscored the important role Kenya plays in furthering the resolution of regional conflicts.
